content.title: How retail theft is hitting luxury brand Mackage
content.description:
Opening Bid Unfiltered is available on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, YouTube, or wherever you get your podcasts.

Brazen retail theft is moving from viral videos to a daily cost of doing business. On this Opening Bid Unfiltered clip, Yahoo Finance’s Brian Sozzi presses Mackage CEO Tanya Golesic on how organized shoplifters are targeting luxury outerwear, from Nordstrom racks in suburban malls to the brand’s own Madison Avenue and Soho stores. Golesic explains that groups can clear entire racks in seconds, sometimes hitting locations two or three times a week, even with security guards on site, while staff are told not to intervene for safety reasons. She also connects the trend to a wider retail crisis, pointing out that if basic items at drugstores are locked up, it is no surprise high-end brands like Mackage are feeling the impact too.

Listen on your favorite podcast platform or watch on our website for full episodes of Opening Bid Unfiltered.

This post was written by Langston Sessoms, producer for Opening Bid Unfiltered.
